tagline.text: An Ortigas indoor destination for a chosen mix of shopping, dining and skating

location.label: Location
location.text: EDSA and Julia Vargas Avenue area, Ortigas Center, Mandaluyong, Metro Manila

best_season.label: Best time to visit
best_season.text: Indoor visits year-round; check holiday events and special hours separately

duration.label: Time needed
duration.text: Allow 3–5 hours; a day with skating or a film

budget.label: Budget
budget.text: Personal half-day allowance for food, local transport and a reserve; purchases, paid activities, parking, flights and lodging excluded

airport.label: Nearest airport
airport.text: Ninoy Aquino International Airport; visit from your Metro Manila accommodation

children.text: SM Megamall is a
large connected shopping complex

in Ortigas Center, Mandaluyong. Combine shops and dining with optional skating or a film for a half-day or longer visit. With phased redevelopment under way, prioritize the current directory and open routes over old floor guides.

A first visit can involve more walking than expected through long wings and repeated retail levels. Learn the names Mega A, Mega B and Mega Fashion Hall, then mark two or three desired shops or activities on one map. A meeting point with a building, floor and nearby store is more useful than “the main entrance.” Distinguish Megamall from the wider Ortigas district and neighboring malls.

Browse clothing and homewares or come simply for a meal. Skating, cinema or a dated exhibition can extend the visit to a day. Build around one preferred activity rather than attempting every attraction. Although useful in rain, the trip from a station and some connecting sections are not necessarily sheltered.

SM Prime announced a major phased redevelopment in 2025. Do not treat proposed landscaping, cinema or parking changes as facilities already completed; ask staff about areas open now. Photographs here date from 2014 to 2026 and identify their year. Older decorations, storefronts and entrances may differ on your visit.

blocks.title: Browse Mega A and Mega B

children.text: Explore the central retail passages and their multilevel layout. A chosen product category helps avoid repeated walking. Use the directory to identify the exact branch and floor rather than relying only on a brand name.

Mega Fashion Hall is another part of the complex. Browse its shops and compare the displays and circulation with the other wings. A store visible in an older photo may have changed; check the current directory for an essential brand.

An ice session makes a distinctive break from the tropical city. Skating is a separate paid activity with its own sessions. Confirm opening, last admission, rentals, lessons and child conditions, and distinguish watching from time actually spent on the ice.

Choose the auditorium, language and start time before fitting in a film. Standard and premium screenings can have different terms. Locate your booked auditorium first and arrange meals and shopping nearby instead of rushing from another wing at the last moment.

blocks.title: Choose a food-court or restaurant meal

children.text: Choose a quick food-court stop or a seated meal. Allow time to compare menus for a group and save the building and floor. Old menu prices and blanket claims about discounts or payment methods are not reliable current terms.

Megatrade Hall hosts dated book, homeware and hobby events. Check the dates, hall and ticket or registration conditions. A past fair does not mean the same exhibition runs daily, and event admission is separate from entering the mall.
Look up two or three shops and a dining area. If skating or cinema is the priority, confirm its booking or session first and fit shopping around it.
Identify your arrival wing and open connections. Find a restroom and the intended return exit on the map, then begin with your chosen section.
Browse and compare your chosen products with a meal break. Leave additional time for skating preparation and rentals, and avoid squeezing it in if shopping overruns.
Add one short wing visit or a café break to organize purchases. Allow a full day if adding a film, and check rush-hour traffic before choosing your return transport.
This suggested sequence should follow open routes and activity times; the mall, cinema and ice rink do not necessarily share one schedule.

Ortigas and Shaw Boulevard on MRT 3 are useful access points. The better choice depends on your destination wing and open entrance. Do not follow old advice naming Boni as the nearest station. Check pedestrian links and crossings from the station exit on a map and local signs; on the EDSA Busway (Carousel) side, a covered station link to Mega A was reported under construction in 2025-2026, so confirm whether it is open and which section on the day. Never cross the main road between moving vehicles.

Enter “SM Megamall, Mandaluyong” and a wing name. Confirm an authorized pickup or drop-off point in the app and on-site signs and share it with your group. EDSA traffic direction and one-way roads may require a detour even when the mall is visible. Avoid fixed travel-time assumptions and leave room for rain and rush-hour congestion.

For an airport-day visit, put flight timing first. Megamall is not an airport facility, and luggage storage is not guaranteed. Visiting from your hotel is easier unless storage and transport are arranged. Confirm the airport terminal before booking a vehicle and set a firm shopping cutoff.

Indoor shopping works throughout the year, but expect more walking and queues on weekends, event dates and during the holiday season. Choose a weekday for unhurried comparison, or plan around the specific activity schedule. Hours can change with the season and special notices; check both current mall notices and the desired facility before travel.

children.text: During construction, even a familiar shop may require a different route. Follow current signs instead of relying on remembered escalators or links. On a day with major transport disruption, an open mall does not guarantee an easy return; be ready to shorten the trip. Christmas displays are seasonal rather than permanent scenery.
These figures are a
personal half-day planning allowance

, not an admission package. They cover food, local transport and a reserve. Add purchases and activities separately. Skating and cinema charges depend on sessions, seats, rentals and promotions, so check the actual date and branch rather than relying on an old guide.

items.label: Meals and drinks
items.note: Personal allowance adjusted to your menu choices

items.label: Local transport
items.note: Adjust for origin, mode and party size; airport excluded

items.label: Reserve
items.note: Contingency for extra travel or changed plans

children.text: The total is ₱900–1,800 per person, excluding purchases, skating, cinema, event tickets, parking, flights and lodging. Read activity duration, shoe and helmet inclusions and change terms. A voucher for another SM branch or a limited event is not automatically valid at Megamall; verify the branch and dates at checkout.

A half-day from your existing Metro Manila accommodation is usually sufficient. For repeated shopping or Ortigas business, compare nearby hotels by actual pedestrian and vehicle entrances rather than apparent distance or hotel name. Hotel facilities are not automatically available to mall visitors.

Choose between a quick food-court meal and a seated restaurant. Pick a dining area during browsing so hunger does not lead to a long search in another wing. Ask staff about ingredients and preparation for children, allergies or dietary needs. Use the current menu rather than potentially old search results, and leave time for water and rest.

Avoid a rushed meal immediately before a booked film or skate session. Check what to do with shopping bags and outer layers before an ice activity. If splitting up, agree an easy indoor meeting place and time and check phone batteries. Wi-Fi and stroller or wheelchair loans are not guaranteed at all times.
Save each desired store’s wing and floor as well as its name. If the map has changed, ask staff about the current link instead of following an old blog’s passage photographs.

Before paying for a first skate session, ask about beginner guidance, lessons, age, clothing and protective gear. Check spectator conditions too; ordinary mall clothing and ice-activity preparation are different considerations.

Verify a Megatrade event’s dates, hall and organizer. Do not transfer a past event’s free admission or discounts to another one. Use official ticket channels and confirm entry and registration terms; switch to shopping and dining if no suitable event runs.

Wear comfortable walking shoes and carry a manageable bag. Compare receipts and exchange terms along with goods; separate stores do not share identical discounts or warranties. Consider gift size, weight and storage for the remainder of the trip.

Megamall is undergoing phased redevelopment. Respect works barriers and closed links, follow current signs and distinguish proposed facilities from those operating now. Reconfirm the entrance to a booked store or activity.
Use marked pedestrian links across EDSA and internal driveways. Wait at an authorized pickup place rather than in a traffic lane. Keep bags from blocking your view and slow down at wet entrances.

Keep bags and phones close and supervise children around busy passages and escalators. Confirm elevator routes for strollers or wheelchairs on site. Groups should agree a named exit in case they become separated.

Follow rink staff guidance and skate within your ability. A rink photograph does not guarantee immediate walk-in availability. Tell staff if unwell or if equipment does not fit, and avoid forcing an unsuitable activity.

Check the vehicle and destination before departure and organize receipts, cards and purchases. On a flight day, prioritize airport departure over one more purchase. Traffic, rain and rail changes can extend the return journey.
The wider business and commercial district containing Megamall. Check actual building locations before adding another dining or shopping area, and choose just one if already tired.
A separate San Juan destination for tiangge stalls and multiple shopping buildings. It is not connected inside Megamall; allow a transfer and consider a different day if the shopping goals overlap.
A different district for an outdoor city walk and dinner after indoor browsing. Decide according to traffic and remaining energy rather than expecting a reliably short drive.
